convars.name: resources_useSystemChat
convars.description: TEMPORARY convar for chat build swaparound

convars.name: sv_defaultGameBuild
convars.description:
sv_defaultGameBuild mandates the default game executable build that clients must use.
This allows the server to control which executable clients run without requiring all clients to update simultaneously.

convars.name: sv_endpoints
convars.description:
list of space-separated endpoints that can but don't have to include a port
for example: sv_endpoints "123.123.123.123 124.124.124.124"

convars.name: sv_forceIndirectListing
convars.description: sv_forceIndirectListing will break listings if the proxy host can not be reached

convars.name: sv_listingHostOverride
convars.description:
sv_listingHostOverride specifies a host to use as reverse proxy endpoint instead of the default
reverse TCP server
